technical.summary: Strong volume and momentum divergence signals (CMF, Force Index, OBV) conflict with weak MACD, price below 50-MA, and Ichimoku cloud positioning; moderate confluence with elevated overbought risk.

fundamental.summary: ABBV shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 64 days present material risk.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals with no congressional conviction, greed-zone caution warranting restraint, and insufficient news data to confirm directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (69.16) indicates extreme market fear, and earnings in 64 days adds event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset for multinational ABBV.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong volume spike (15x), CMF/Force Index/OBV bullish crossovers, and Supertrend/ParabolicSAR alignment suggest institutional accumulation breaking through resistance at 127.64.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below 50-MA and Ichimoku cloud with negative MACD histogram, zero fundamental conviction, VIX crisis levels (69.16), inverted yield curve, and earnings event risk in 64 days create asymmetric downside risk.
